problems.title: Course Schedule
problems.notes: detect a cycle via Kahn's BFS or 3-color DFS — a cycle exists iff not all nodes get ordered

problems.title: Course Schedule II
problems.notes: same as Course Schedule but return the actual order — Kahn's BFS is the natural fit since it builds the order directly

problems.title: Find Eventual Safe States
problems.notes: topo sort on the reversed graph (or 3-color DFS) to find nodes that can never reach a cycle

problems.title: Minimum Height Trees
problems.notes: leaf-trimming BFS ('onion peeling') — a topological-sort-flavored technique for finding a tree's centroid(s)

problems.title: Sequence Reconstruction
problems.notes: topo sort uniqueness check: the order is unique iff exactly one node has indegree 0 at every step

problems.title: Parallel Courses
problems.notes: Kahn's BFS where the answer is the number of levels/rounds processed, not the order itself

problems.title: Find All Possible Recipes from Given Supplies
problems.notes: topo sort where raw supplies are pre-satisfied indegree-0 nodes; recipes unlock only once all ingredients are ready

problems.title: Alien Dictionary
problems.notes: build edges from the first differing letter of adjacent words, then topo sort; watch the 'longer word is a prefix' invalid case

problems.title: Build a Matrix With Conditions
problems.notes: topo sort on rows and columns independently and simultaneously, then combine the two orderings into one matrix
